summary: Full verification of iteration 17 features: withholding certificates report (/reports/withholding), tax deadlines calendar (/deadlines) + cron endpoint, notification pref 'Φορολογική προθεσμία', bulk actions (issue, mark_paid, myDATA, email) on /invoices, late-charges → document button. All acceptance criteria PASS except one MEDIUM concern: the /api/cron/deadlines endpoint has no server-side dedup so if today were 7/1/0 days before a deadline, two calls in a row would create duplicate notifications (could not exercise today because notified=0 both times; nearest deadline is 18 days away).

minor.issue: No server-side dedup: notify() blindly inserts a notification row. If today matched days ∈ {0,1,7}, two consecutive cron calls would double-notify users. Add a uniqueness key such as (orgId, type, link, DATE(createdAt)) or skip when a notification with the same title exists for today.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Add idempotency to POST /api/cron/deadlines: dedup by (orgId, type='tax_deadline', link='/deadlines', title, DATE(createdAt)) so re-running the daily cron does not create duplicate 'σε 7 ημέρες / λήγει αύριο / λήγει σήμερα' notifications. Currently notify() inserts blindly.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance.ts::taxDeadlines — Ε3/Ε1 (30/06) and ΜΥΦ (28/02) are always sliced away by .slice(0,12) because 4 full monthly cycles (ΑΠΔ+ΦΜΥ ×4 + 1 quarterly Φ2 = 9 items) already fill the window before June/February appear. Consider promoting annual codes above monthly ones or increasing the window to 15, or grouping monthly items into a single 'ΦΜΥ+ΑΠΔ' card so annual deadlines remain visible.
notifications.ts::notify — no dedup key. Combined with the daily cron this can spam users on consecutive runs within the same day (or if the cron retries).

bulk.ts::bulkInvoiceAction — for op='mark_paid' the payment method is copied from the invoice (`inv.paymentMethod`), which is fine, but if a customer has already paid with a different method the value is not editable in the mass flow. Non-blocking; a note in the confirmation copy would help.

late-charges.ts::invoiceLateChargesAction — hardcodes vatExemptionCategory=14 (άρθρο 28) which is 'χωρίς ΦΠΑ – ενδοκοινοτικές παραδόσεις'. Legally more accurate for Greek late-charge lines would be category 15 (άρθρο 22 – εκτός πεδίου / έξοδα τόκων) or 16 (άρθρο 39 – ειδικό καθεστώς). Confirm with tax counsel; currently the invoice renders 'Απαλλαγή ΦΠΑ: Χωρίς ΦΠΑ – άρθρο 28 του Κώδικα ΦΠΑ (ενδοκοινοτικές παραδόσεις)' which is not the correct exemption reason for late-fee income.

reports/withholding/page.tsx — years list is [year+1, year, year-1, year-2] filtered to ≤ currentYear+1. Works, but if the user manually navigates to ?year=2020 the chip row will not include the active year and the badge on 'active' will not show; consider `Array.from(new Set([...defaultYears, year]))`.

deadlines/page.tsx — data-testid pattern deadline-<code>-<date> uses Greek letters in the DOM (e.g. deadline-ΑΠΔ-2026-09-30). Works but selectors need to be URL-encoded for some tooling. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: Duplicate notification risk on daily cron: /api/cron/deadlines calls notify() for every deadline matching days ∈ {0,1,7}. notify() only inserts (no read-before-write). If the deadlines-daily 08:00 job retries (network, k8s restart) users receive duplicate in-app + email alerts for the same deadline. Mitigation: add SELECT-then-INSERT check keyed on (orgId, type='tax_deadline', link, title, DATE(createdAt)), or store a hash column with a UNIQUE index.
